title: Auli Joshimath (2N/3D)
reportingPoint: Delhi. Departure at 9 PM on the departure night; the exact pickup point is shared with confirmed travellers before the trip.
overview:
India's snow playground from Delhi: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** group trip drives past the Panch Prayag confluences to Joshimath, then spends a full day at Auli with its cable car, Nanda Devi views, skiing and snowboarding, and ends with a music-party night.

You leave Delhi at 9 PM by tempo traveller and drive up via Haridwar and Rishikesh and along the Badrinath road past Devprayag, Rudraprayag, Karnaprayag and Nandprayag. Day 1 is a relaxed day in Joshimath, Day 2 is snow day at Auli (12 km, about 1 hour away), and Day 3 is the drive back, reaching Delhi early on Day 4. Two hotel nights, 2 breakfasts and 2 dinners and a trip coordinator are included; the cable car and winter sports are at your own cost. Prices start at ₹7,000 per person on quad sharing, plus 5% GST.
highlights: The Panch Prayag drive: Devprayag, Rudraprayag, Karnaprayag and Nandprayag
Haridwar and Rishikesh on the way up
Auli cable car with views of Nanda Devi and Nar Parvat (own cost)
Skiing and snowboarding on Auli's slopes (own cost)
A relaxed leisure day in Joshimath
Music party night at the hotel

itinerary.title: Delhi to Joshimath | Overnight journey
itinerary.content:
Assemble at the pickup point at 9 PM, meet your team captain and the group, and depart by tempo traveller.
Halt for dinner on the way (not included).

itinerary.title: Joshimath arrival and leisure
itinerary.content:
Drive up via Haridwar and Rishikesh, two of India's holiest cities.
Take the Badrinath road past the confluences of the Ganga: Devprayag, Rudraprayag, Karnaprayag and Nandprayag, with the Alaknanda flowing alongside.
Check in at the hotel; the rest of the day is at leisure.
Dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Joshimath to Auli | Snow day
itinerary.content:
Early breakfast, then head to Auli (12 km, about 1 hour), overlooked by Nanda Devi and Nar Parvat.
Reach Auli top by cable car (own cost) or by road, and try skiing, snowboarding and more (own cost).
Back to the hotel for dinner, a music party and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Back to Delhi
itinerary.content:
Early breakfast and check-out.
Drive back to Delhi via Rishikesh, reaching Delhi on Day 4. The trip ends.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: From Delhi, at 9 PM on the departure night, by tempo traveller. The exact pickup point is shared with confirmed travellers before the trip. You are back in Delhi early on Day 4.

faqs.q: How much does the Auli trip cost?
faqs.a: On regular dates: ₹7,000 per person on quad sharing, ₹7,500 on triple and ₹8,000 on double. Christmas (24 and 25 December) and New Year (30 December) departures have their own price, shown when you pick that date. 5% GST is extra.

2 nights in a hotel, 2 breakfasts and 2 dinners, Delhi to Delhi transport by tempo traveller, sightseeing as per the itinerary, a music party, a trip coordinator and extra mattresses for triple and quad sharing.

faqs.q: Are the cable car and skiing included?
faqs.a: No. The Auli cable car (ropeway), 4x4 vehicles, skiing, snowboarding and other winter sports are at your own cost.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Pay ₹3,000 per person to reserve your seat, by UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking. The balance is due 24 hours before boarding.
The ₹3,000 advance isn't refunded under any circumstances, and there are no refunds for inclusions you don't use.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: Auli is freezing in winter, so pack a down jacket, thermals, socks and gloves, plus a valid government photo ID: there is no boarding without it. The full list is under Things To Pack.
